title: Omanic: Towards Step-wise Evaluation of Multi-hop Reasoning in Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2603.16654v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Evaluating the reasoning abilities of large language models (LLMs) solely from final answers can obscure failures in intermediate steps, especially in multi-hop QA benchmarks without step-level annotations. To address this gap, we introduce Omanic, an open-domain 4-hop QA benchmark designed not only to measure final-answer accuracy but also to diagnose where reasoning breaks down. Omanic contains 10,296 machine-generated training examples (OmanicSynth) and 967 expert-reviewed human-annotated evaluation examples (OmanicBench), with each evaluation question decomposed into single-hop sub-questions, intermediate answers, and structured graph topologies. Experiments with proprietary and open-source LLMs show that Omanic is challenging, while step-wise analysis reveals a later-hop bottleneck, factual knowledge floor, and error propagation along reasoning chains. translated_title: 奥马尼克：迈向大语言模型多跳推理的逐步评估
translated_abstract: 摘要：仅从最终答案评估大语言模型（LLMs）的推理能力，可能会掩盖中间步骤中的失败，尤其是在没有步骤级标注的多跳问答基准中。为弥补这一空白，我们引入了奥马尼克（Omanic），一个开放领域的4跳问答基准，它不仅用于衡量最终答案的准确性，还用于诊断推理在何处中断。奥马尼克包含10,296个机器生成的训练示例（OmanicSynth）和967个经专家审核的人工标注评估示例（OmanicBench），每个评估问题都被分解为单跳子问题、中间答案和结构化图拓扑。实验表明，无论是专有还是开源LLMs，奥马尼克都具有挑战性，而逐步分析揭示了后期跳数瓶颈、事实知识下限以及沿推理链的错误传播。在OmanicSynth上进行微调可迁移到六个推理和数学基准。
tldr: 本文提出奥马尼克（Omanic），一个带逐步标注的4跳问答基准，通过分解子问题和中间答案来诊断多跳推理中的后期瓶颈与错误传播，并验证了微调训练数据的跨任务迁移性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Omanic, a step-annotated 4-hop QA benchmark that decomposes sub-questions and intermediate answers to diagnose later-hop bottlenecks and error propagation in multi-hop reasoning, while demonstrating the transferability of fine-tuning on its synthetic data to other reasoning tasks.
